';

function v310DrawCard(id){
 const d=DEVICES.find(x=>x.id===id);
 if(!d) return '';
 if(!state.completed.includes(id)){
  return `<div class="v310-slot locked" aria-label="まだ手に入れていないカード番号${id}"><span class="v310-lock-icon">✦</span><span class="v310-no">No.${String(id).padStart(2,'0')}</span><span class="v310-locked-text">まだ GET していないよ</span></div>`;
 }
 return `<button type="button" class="v310-slot unlocked ${recentStarId===id?'new-get':''}" data-v310-card="${id}" aria-label="No.${id} ${dName(d)}のスターカードを読む">${starCardArt(d)}</button>`;
}

function v310AlbumHTML(){
 const left=Array.from({length:6},(_,i)=>v310DrawCard(i+1)).join('');
 const right=Array.from({length:6},(_,i)=>v310DrawCard(i+7)).join('');
 return `<div class="v310-album"><div class="v310-album-bar"><span class="v310-total">★ GET ${state.completed.length} / 12</span><span class="v310-goal">カードをあつめて 全12枚をコンプリートしよう！</span><span class="v310-secret-count">✨ ひみつ ${state.secrets.length} / 4</span></div><div class="v310-book-stage" id="v310-book-stage"><div class="v310-open-book" id="v310-open-book" role="group" aria-label="本全体を表示した左右2ページのカードファイル"><img class="v310-book-base" src="${V310_OPEN_BOOK}" alt="" draggable="false"><section class="v310-page left" aria-label="左ページ カード1から6">${left}</section><section class="v310-page right" aria-label="右ページ カード7から12">${right}</section></div></div><div class="v310-album-footer"><span class="v310-instruction">GETしたカードはタップで大きく読めるよ</span><button type="button" id="v310-map-back">マップへもどる</button></div></div>`;
}

function v310FitBook(){
 const stage=$('v310-book-stage'),book=$('v310-open-book'); if(!stage||!book)return;
 const box=stage.getBoundingClientRect(),ratio=1536/1024;
 const rotate=matchMedia('(max-width:720px) and (orientation:portrait)').matches;
 const availableW=Math.max(box.width-6,0),availableH=Math.max(box.height-6,0);
 // Entire original book remains visible at its exact natural aspect ratio.
 const width=rotate?Math.min(availableH,availableW*ratio):Math.min(availableW,availableH*ratio);
 book.style.width=`${Math.max(width,0)}px`;
 book.style.height=`${Math.max(width/ratio,0)}px`;
 book.classList.toggle('rotated',rotate);

}

function v310ClosePreview(){
 const over=document.getElementById('v310-detail-cover');
 if(over) over.remove();
}
function v310PreviewCard(id){
 const d=DEVICES.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!d||!state.completed.includes(id))return;
 v310ClosePreview();
 const cover=document.createElement('div');
 cover.id='v310-detail-cover';cover.className='v310-preview show';
 cover.innerHTML=`<div class="v310-detail" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="${dName(d)}のカードの内容"><img class="v310-detail-img" src="${STAR_CARD_IMAGES[id]}" alt="${dName(d)}のオリジナルスターカード"><div class="v310-detail-panel"><strong>★ No.${String(id).padStart(2,'0')} ${dName(d)}</strong><p>${tx(d.desc)}</p><button type="button" id="v310-preview-back">本にもどる</button></div></div>`;
 document.body.appendChild(cover);
 cover.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===cover)v310ClosePreview()});
 document.getElementById('v310-preview-back').onclick=v310ClosePreview;
 document.getElementById('v310-preview-back').focus();
}

openGuide=function(){
 dismissCardCapture();
 v310ClosePreview();
 openModal('guide',`⭐ スターカードファイル　${state.completed.length} / 12`,v310AlbumHTML());
 $('v310-map-back').onclick=()=>{v310ClosePreview();closeModal()};
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-v310-card]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>v310PreviewCard(Number(b.dataset.v310Card))));
 requestAnimationFrame(v310FitBook);
};
window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{if($('v310-open-book'))v310FitBook()});
window.addEventListener('orientationchange',()=>{if($('v310-open-book'))setTimeout(v310FitBook,80)});
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')v310ClosePreview()});

const v310CaptureDismissOriginal=dismissCardCapture;
dismissCardCapture=function(){
 clearTimeout(window._cardEffectTimer);clearTimeout(window._cardEffectTimer2);
 const host=$('cardCaptureOverlay');
 if(host){host.onclick=null;host.classList.remove('visible','animate','collected','ready');host.replaceChildren();host.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true')}
};
launchCardCapture=function(d){
 const host=$('cardCaptureOverlay');if(!host)return;
 dismissCardCapture();
 host.innerHTML=`<div class="cardCaptureSpark">✦　★　✧</div><div class="cardCaptureFront">${starCardArt(d)}</div><div class="cardCaptureLabel">★ スターカード GET！</div><div class="v310-get-panel"><h3>★ ${dName(d)}</h3><p>${tx(d.desc)}</p><small>10秒後に 自動でファイルに収納するよ！ タップで先に収納もできるよ</small></div><div class="cardCaptureFolder"><b>📕</b><span>カードファイルに収納！</span></div>`;
 host.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
 host.classList.add('visible');void host.offsetWidth;
 requestAnimationFrame(()=>host.classList.add('animate'));
 let collected=false,started=Date.now();
 const collect=()=>{
  if(collected)return;collected=true;
  clearTimeout(window._cardEffectTimer);
  host.classList.add('collected');
  window._cardEffectTimer2=setTimeout(()=>dismissCardCapture(),850);
 };
 window._cardEffectTimer=setTimeout(collect,10000);
 host.onclick=()=>{if(Date.now()-started>650)collect()};
};

// Remove the inherited stale book overlays in the preparation room and retain a visible, frame-free glow.
(function(){
 const prep=V26_ROOMS.find(r=>r.key==='prep'); if(prep)prep.secret=0;
 const wash=V26_ROOMS.find(r=>r.key==='wash'); if(wash)wash.secret=1;
 const storage=V26_ROOMS.find(r=>r.key==='storage'); if(storage)storage.secret=2;
 function positionBooks(){
  const board=document.getElementById('v26-room-grid');if(!board)return;
  for(const book of board.querySelectorAll('.v26-room .v26-secret')){
   const room=book.closest('.v26-room');if(!room)continue;
   const r=room.getBoundingClientRect();const size=book.getBoundingClientRect();
   if(r.width<size.width+8||r.height<size.height+8)continue;
   const labels=[...room.querySelectorAll('.v26-device strong, .v26-room-head h2, .v26-room-head small')].map(el=>el.getBoundingClientRect());
   const targets=[...room.querySelectorAll('.v26-device img')].map(el=>el.getBoundingClientRect());
   const options=[
    [r.width-size.width-12, r.height-size.height-82],
    [r.width-size.width-12, 17],
    [r.width-size.width-12, 74],
    [r.width-size.width-12, r.height-size.height-16],
    [12, r.height-size.height-13],
    [12, 83],
    [Math.max(12,(r.width-size.width)/2),Math.max(15,(r.height-size.height)/2)]
   ];
   let best=null,bestScore=Infinity;
   for(const [x0,y0] of options){
    const x=Math.max(4,Math.min(x0,r.width-size.width-4));
    const y=Math.max(4,Math.min(y0,r.height-size.height-4));
    const test={left:r.left+x-5,right:r.left+x+size.width+5,top:r.top+y-5,bottom:r.top+y+size.height+5};
    const overlap=(b)=>Math.max(0,Math.min(test.right,b.right)-Math.max(test.left,b.left))*Math.max(0,Math.min(test.bottom,b.bottom)-Math.max(test.top,b.top));
    const labelPenalty=labels.reduce((n,b)=>n+overlap(b),0);
    const imagePenalty=targets.reduce((n,b)=>n+overlap(b),0);
    const preferred=room.classList.contains('v26-wash')?Math.abs(y-(r.height-size.height-82))*0.5:0;
    const score=labelPenalty*100+imagePenalty*0.035+preferred;
    if(score<bestScore){bestScore=score;best=[x,y]}
   }
   if(!best)continue;
   book.style.setProperty('left',best[0]+'px','important');
   book.style.setProperty('top',best[1]+'px','important');
   book.style.setProperty('right','auto','important');
   book.style.setProperty('bottom','auto','important');
   book.style.setProperty('transform','none','important');
  }
 }
 const originalRenderBoard=v26RenderBoard;
 v26RenderBoard=function(){originalRenderBoard()};
 if(document.querySelector('#v26-room-grid')) v26RenderBoard();
 window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{if(document.querySelector('#v26-room-grid'))requestAnimationFrame(positionBooks)});
})();
document.querySelectorAll('.buildVersion,.v26-version').forEach(e=>e.textContent='Ver.3.25');

// ===== Ver.3.11 album / capture / complete page polish =====
(function(){
const V311_COMPLETE_ILLUST = 'data:image/webp;base64,';
const V311_ALBUM_PAGES = [
  {cards:[1,2,3,4], label:'1 / 4 ページ'},
  {cards:[5,6,7,8], label:'2 / 4 ページ'},
  {cards:[9,10,11,12], label:'3 / 4 ページ'},
  {complete:true, label:'4 / 4 ページ'}
];
window.v311AlbumPage = Math.min(window.v311AlbumPage||0, V311_ALBUM_PAGES.length-1);

function v311ClampPage(n){
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(V311_ALBUM_PAGES.length-1, n|0));
}

function v311CardSlot(id){
  const got = state.completed.includes(id);
  if(got){
    return `<button type="button" class="v311-slot unlocked" data-v311-card="${id}" aria-label="${dName(DEVICES.find(x=>x.id===id))}のカードを読む">${starCardArt(DEVICES.find(x=>x.id===id))}</button>`;
  }
  return `<div class="v311-slot locked" aria-label="No.${String(id).padStart(2,'0')} 未獲得"><span class="v311-lock-icon">🔒</span><span class="v311-no">No.${String(id).padStart(2,'0')}</span><span class="v311-locked-text">未獲得</span></div>`;
}

function v311AlbumHTML(){
  const page = V311_ALBUM_PAGES[v311ClampPage(window.v311AlbumPage||0)];
  let inner = '';
  if(page.complete){
    const unlocked = state.completed.length === 12;
    inner = `<div class="v311-complete-spread ${unlocked?'unlocked':'locked'}" aria-label="コンプリートページ">` +
      (unlocked
        ? `<img src="${V311_COMPLETE_ILLUST}" alt="コンプリートおめでとうイラスト"><div class="v311-complete-badge">コンプリートおめでとう！</div><p class="v311-complete-copy">12枚のスターカードをぜんぶ集めたね！</p>`
        : `<div class="v311-complete-lock"><div class="v311-complete-lock-icon">🔒</div><h3>さいごのページ</h3><p>スターカードを12枚ぜんぶ集めると<br>コンプリートおめでとう！イラストが見られるよ</p></div>`)
      + `</div>`;
  } else {
    const left = page.cards.slice(0,2).map(v311CardSlot).join('');
    const right = page.cards.slice(2,4).map(v311CardSlot).join('');
    inner = `<section class="v311-page left" aria-label="左ページ">${left}</section><section class="v311-page right" aria-label="右ページ">${right}</section>`;
  }
  return `<div class="v311-album"><div class="v311-album-bar"><span class="v311-total">★ GET ${state.completed.length} / 12</span><span class="v311-goal">カードを集めてスターカードファイルを完成させよう！</span><span class="v311-secret-count">✨ ひみつ ${state.secrets.length} / 4</span></div><div class="v311-book-stage" id="v311-book-stage"><div class="v311-open-book" id="v311-open-book" role="group" aria-label="開いたスターカードファイル"><img class="v311-book-base" src="${V310_OPEN_BOOK}" alt="" draggable="false">${inner}</div></div><div class="v311-album-footer"><button type="button" id="v311-prev" ${(window.v311AlbumPage||0)<=0?'disabled':''}>〈前のページ</button><span class="v311-page-indicator">${page.label}</span><button type="button" id="v311-next" ${(window.v311AlbumPage||0)>=V311_ALBUM_PAGES.length-1?'disabled':''}>次のページ〉</button><button type="button" id="v311-map-back">マップへもどる</button></div></div>`;
}

const V311_MOBILE_BOOK='data:image/webp;base64,';
function v311FitBook(){
  const stage=document.getElementById('v311-book-stage');
  const book=document.getElementById('v311-open-book');
  if(!stage||!book)return;
  const box=stage.getBoundingClientRect();
  const widthSpace=Math.max(box.width-8,0),heightSpace=Math.max(box.height-8,0);
  const base=book.querySelector('.v311-book-base');
  const portrait=matchMedia('(max-width:720px) and (orientation:portrait)').matches;
  if(portrait){
    const ratio=2/3;
    const width=Math.min(widthSpace,heightSpace*ratio);
    book.style.width=`${Math.max(width,0)}px`;
    book.style.height=`${Math.max(width/ratio,0)}px`;
    book.classList.add('mobilePortrait');
    book.classList.remove('rotated');
    if(base && base.src!==V311_MOBILE_BOOK)base.src=V311_MOBILE_BOOK;
  }else{
    const ratio=1536/1024;
    const width=Math.min(widthSpace,heightSpace*ratio);
    book.style.width=`${Math.max(width,0)}px`;
    book.style.height=`${Math.max(width/ratio,0)}px`;
    book.classList.remove('rotated','mobilePortrait');
    if(base && base.src!==V310_OPEN_BOOK)base.src=V310_OPEN_BOOK;
  }
}

function v311ClosePreview(){
  const over=document.getElementById('v311-detail-cover');
  if(over) over.remove();
}
window.v311ClosePreview = v311ClosePreview;

function v311PreviewCard(id){
  const d=DEVICES.find(x=>x.id===id);
  if(!d || !state.completed.includes(id)) return;
  v311ClosePreview();
  const cover=document.createElement('div');
  cover.id='v311-detail-cover';
  cover.className='v311-preview show';
  cover.innerHTML=`<div class="v311-detail" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="${dName(d)}のカードの内容"><img class="v311-detail-img" src="${STAR_CARD_IMAGES[id]}" alt="${dName(d)}のスターカード"><div class="v311-detail-panel"><strong>★ No.${String(id).padStart(2,'0')} ${dName(d)}</strong><p>${tx(d.desc)}</p><button type="button" id="v311-preview-back">カードに収納</button></div></div>`;
  document.body.appendChild(cover);
  cover.addEventListener('click',e=>{ if(e.target===cover) v311ClosePreview(); });
  const btn=document.getElementById('v311-preview-back');
  if(btn){ btn.onclick=v311ClosePreview; btn.focus(); }
}

function v311RenderAlbum(){
  const root=document.getElementById('v311-album-root');
  if(!root) return;
  root.innerHTML=v311AlbumHTML();
  const back=document.getElementById('v311-map-back');
  if(back) back.onclick=()=>{ v311ClosePreview(); closeModal(); };
  const prev=document.getElementById('v311-prev');
  if(prev) prev.onclick=()=>{ window.v311AlbumPage=v311ClampPage((window.v311AlbumPage||0)-1); v311ClosePreview(); v311RenderAlbum(); };
  const next=document.getElementById('v311-next');
  if(next) next.onclick=()=>{ window.v311AlbumPage=v311ClampPage((window.v311AlbumPage||0)+1); v311ClosePreview(); v311RenderAlbum(); };
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-v311-card]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>v311PreviewCard(Number(b.dataset.v311Card))));
  requestAnimationFrame(v311FitBook);
}
window.v311RenderAlbum = v311RenderAlbum;

openGuide=function(){
  dismissCardCapture();
  v311ClosePreview();
  window.v311AlbumPage = v311ClampPage(window.v311AlbumPage||0);
  openModal('guide',`⭐ スターカードファイル　${state.completed.length} / 12`,'<div id="v311-album-root"></div>');
  v311RenderAlbum();
};
window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{ if(document.getElementById('v311-open-book')) v311FitBook(); });
window.addEventListener('orientationchange',()=>{ if(document.getElementById('v311-open-book')) setTimeout(v311FitBook,80); });
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{ if(e.key==='Escape') v311ClosePreview(); });

// card GET overlay layout update
const originalDismissCardCapture = dismissCardCapture;
dismissCardCapture=function(){
  clearTimeout(window._cardEffectTimer); clearTimeout(window._cardEffectTimer2);
  const host=$('cardCaptureOverlay');
  if(host){
    host.onclick=null;
    host.classList.remove('visible','animate','collected','ready','v311-get-mode');
    host.replaceChildren();
    host.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
  }
};
launchCardCapture=function(d){
  const host=$('cardCaptureOverlay'); if(!host) return;
  dismissCardCapture();
  host.innerHTML = `<div class="v311-get-scene"><div class="v311-get-rays"></div><div class="v311-get-title">★ スターカード GET！</div><div class="v311-get-copy"><h3>${dName(d)}</h3><p>${tx(d.desc)}</p><small>10秒後にカードファイルへ自動収納するよ。タップで先に収納もできるよ！</small></div><div class="v311-get-card">${starCardArt(d)}</div><div class="v311-get-binder"><span>📖</span><b>カードファイルへ収納！</b></div></div>`;
  host.classList.add('visible','animate','v311-get-mode');
  host.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
  let collected=false, started=Date.now();
  const collect=()=>{
    if(collected) return;
    collected=true;
    clearTimeout(window._cardEffectTimer);
    host.classList.add('collected');
    window._cardEffectTimer2=setTimeout(()=>dismissCardCapture(), 900);
  };
  window._cardEffectTimer=setTimeout(collect,10000);
  host.onclick=()=>{ if(Date.now()-started>650) collect(); };
};

// secret books: stronger glow, no frame, and position in empty spaces
function v311PositionBooks(){
  const board=document.getElementById('v26-room-grid');
  if(!board) return;
  const mobile = window.innerWidth <= 720;
  board.querySelectorAll('.v26-room .v26-secret').forEach(book=>{
    const room=book.closest('.v26-room');
    if(!room) return;
    book.style.removeProperty('right');
    book.style.removeProperty('left');
    book.style.removeProperty('top');
    book.style.removeProperty('bottom');
    book.style.removeProperty('transform');
    const rw=room.clientWidth, rh=room.clientHeight;
    const bw=book.offsetWidth || (mobile?52:70), bh=book.offsetHeight || (mobile?52:70);
    let x=rw-bw-14, y=rh-bh-18;
    if(room.classList.contains('v26-storage')){
      x = rw - bw - (mobile?8:12);
      y = mobile ? 22 : 14;
    } else if(room.classList.contains('v26-wash')){
      x = rw - bw - (mobile?8:16);
      y = mobile ? 16 : Math.max(18, Math.min(rh*0.48, rh-bh-22));
    } else if(room.classList.contains('v26-clean')){
      x = rw - bw - (mobile?8:16);
      y = mobile ? rh*0.52 : rh - bh - 18;
    }
    book.style.setProperty('left',`${Math.max(6,x)}px`,'important');
    book.style.setProperty('top',`${Math.max(6,y)}px`,'important');
    book.style.setProperty('right','auto','important');
    book.style.setProperty('bottom','auto','important');
    book.style.setProperty('transform','none','important');
  });
}
const v311PrevRenderBoard = v26RenderBoard;
v26RenderBoard=function(){
  v311PrevRenderBoard();
  requestAnimationFrame(v311PositionBooks);
  setTimeout(v311PositionBooks,70);
};
if(document.getElementById('v26-room-grid')) v26RenderBoard();
window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{ if(document.getElementById('v26-room-grid')) requestAnimationFrame(v311PositionBooks); });

    .v311-open-book.mobilePortrait .v311-page.right{right:10.0%!important}

  }
  `;
  document.head.appendChild(fixCSS);
  // Earlier versions assigned the old openGuide function by value to the button.
  // Rebind it to the newest implementation dynamically.
  const guideBtn=document.getElementById('openGuide');
  if(guideBtn)guideBtn.onclick=function(e){if(e)e.preventDefault();openGuide();};
  // End and mission buttons are created later: override any stale event handler at capture phase.
  document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    const trigger=e.target&&e.target.closest&&e.target.closest('#endGuide,#missionGuide');
    if(!trigger)return;
    e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();openGuide();
  },true);
  // Preview Escape should close only the card preview.
  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
    if(e.key==='Escape'&&document.getElementById('v311-detail-cover')){
      e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();
      if(typeof window.v311ClosePreview==='function')window.v311ClosePreview();
    }
  },true);
  document.querySelectorAll('.buildVersion,.v26-version').forEach(el=>el.textContent='Ver.3.25');
})();


/* ===== FKI Ver.3.25: cache-busting update check =====
 * Updates on GitHub Pages (HTTP/HTTPS) when the latest published files are available.
 * No new service worker. localStorage / IndexedDB are never cleared.
 * This code cannot rewrite an old local file:// download or bypass network outages.
 */
let fkiLastCheckedAt = 0;
let fkiPendingVersion = '';
let fkiCheckInFlight = null;
let fkiPendingTarget = null;
const FKI_BUILD_ID = 'FKI-3.25-PC-476156c0f1a5e2ac';
const FKI_FLAVOR = 'pc';
const FKI_PROBE_PARAMETER = '__fki_probe';
const FKI_REFRESH_PARAMETER = '__fki_refresh';
const FKI_MANIFEST = 'version.json';
const FKI_APP_ID = 'fupyon-kitchen-secrets';
function fkiBuildFromHead(source) {
  const txt=String(source||'').slice(0,20000);
  const m1=txt.match(/<meta\s+name=["']fupyon-build["']\s+content=["']([0-9.]+)["']/i);
  const m2=txt.match(/<meta\s+name=["']fupyon-build-id["']\s+content=["']([\w.-]+)["']/i);
  const mt=txt.match(/<title>[^<]*?Ver\.([0-9.]+)/i);
  return {version:(m1&&m1[1])||(mt&&mt[1])||'',buildId:(m2&&m2[1])||''};
}
function fkiFolder(){ return new URL('./', location.href); }
function fkiFreshURL(url, key='__fresh') {
  const u=new URL(url, location.href);
  u.searchParams.delete('vcheck');
  u.searchParams.delete(FKI_PROBE_PARAMETER);
  u.searchParams.delete(FKI_REFRESH_PARAMETER);
  u.searchParams.set(key,Date.now().toString(36)+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,9));
  return u;
}
async function fkiFetchWithTimeout(url, maxms=6500) {
  const controller=new AbortController();
  const timer=setTimeout(()=>controller.abort(),maxms);
  try {
    return await fetch(url.toString(), {cache:'no-store',redirect:'follow',signal:controller.signal,headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-cache'}});
  } finally {clearTimeout(timer)}
}
async function fkiReadManifest(){
  const u=fkiFreshURL(new URL(FKI_MANIFEST,fkiFolder()),'__fki_manifest');
  const res=await fkiFetchWithTimeout(u,6500);
  if(!res.ok) throw new Error(`manifest HTTP ${res.status}`);
  const body=await res.json();
  if(!body||body.application!==FKI_APP_ID||!/^[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+){1,3}$/.test(String(body.version||''))) throw new Error('not FKI manifest');
  if(!body.pc||!body.mobile) throw new Error('missing edition');
  const target=body[FKI_FLAVOR];
  if(!target || !/^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\.html$/.test(target.file||'') || !/^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$/.test(target.buildId||'')) throw new Error('unsafe/invalid target');
  return {version:String(body.version),buildId:target.buildId,url:new URL(target.file,fkiFolder()),source:'manifest'};
}
async function fkiProbeRemoteHead(){
  const u=fkiFreshURL(location.href,FKI_PROBE_PARAMETER);
  const controller=new AbortController();
  const timer=setTimeout(()=>controller.abort(),6500);
  try{
    const res=await fetch(u.toString(), {cache:'no-store',redirect:'follow',signal:controller.signal,headers:{'Range':'bytes=0-8191','Cache-Control':'no-cache'}});
    if(!res.ok) throw new Error('probe HTTP '+res.status);
    const ct=res.headers.get('Content-Type')||'';
    if(ct && !/html|text\/plain/i.test(ct)) throw new Error('not HTML');
    let head='';
    if(res.body&&typeof res.body.getReader==='function'){
      const reader=res.body.getReader();const dec=new TextDecoder();
      try{
        while(head.length<20000){
          const chunk=await reader.read(); if(chunk.done) break;
          head+=dec.decode(chunk.value,{stream:true});
          const found=fkiBuildFromHead(head);
          if(found.version && found.buildId) break;
        }
      } finally {try{await reader.cancel()}catch(e){}}
    } else head=(await res.text()).slice(0,20000);
    const v=fkiBuildFromHead(head);
    if(!v.version) throw new Error('no version marker');
    const target=fkiFreshURL(location.href,FKI_REFRESH_PARAMETER);
    return {version:v.version,buildId:v.buildId,url:target,source:'same-page'};
  }finally{clearTimeout(timer);controller.abort()}
}
async function fkiVerifyRemoteTarget(target){
  // Do not navigate to a half-deployed or stale file even when the manifest is new.
  const u=fkiFreshURL(target.url,'__fki_verify');
  const controller=new AbortController();
  const timer=setTimeout(()=>controller.abort(),8000);
  try{
    const res=await fetch(u.toString(),{cache:'no-store',redirect:'follow',signal:controller.signal,headers:{'Range':'bytes=0-8191','Cache-Control':'no-cache'}});
    if(!res.ok) throw new Error('release HTTP '+res.status);
    const ct=res.headers.get('Content-Type')||'';
    if(ct&&!/html|text\/plain/i.test(ct)) throw new Error('release not HTML');
    let prefix='';
    if(res.body&&typeof res.body.getReader==='function'){
      const reader=res.body.getReader();const dec=new TextDecoder();
      try{
        while(prefix.length<20000){
          const x=await reader.read();if(x.done)break;
          prefix+=dec.decode(x.value,{stream:true});
          const h=fkiBuildFromHead(prefix);
          if(h.version&&h.buildId)break;
        }
      }finally{try{await reader.cancel()}catch(e){}}
    }else prefix=(await res.text()).slice(0,20000);
    const head=fkiBuildFromHead(prefix);
    if(!head.version) throw new Error('release missing build marker');
    if(head.version!==target.version) throw new Error('release has wrong version');
    if(target.buildId&&head.buildId!==target.buildId) throw new Error('release has wrong build ID');
    return true;
  }catch(e){
    console.warn('New release not yet available:',e);
    return false;
  }finally{clearTimeout(timer);controller.abort()}
}
function fkiAlreadyAttempted(key){
  const sk='fki_refresh_attempt_'+location.pathname+'_'+key;
  try{
    const old=Number(sessionStorage.getItem(sk)||0);
    if(old && Date.now()-old<90000) return true;
    sessionStorage.setItem(sk,String(Date.now()));return false;
  }catch(e){return new URLSearchParams(location.search).has(FKI_REFRESH_PARAMETER)}
}
function fkiSaveSafely(){
  try{ if(typeof save==='function') save(); }catch(e){}
}
async function fkiNavigateVerified(target, reason='auto'){
  if(!target||!/^https?:$/.test(location.protocol)) return false;
  if(!await fkiVerifyRemoteTarget(target)) return false;
  if(fkiAlreadyAttempted(target.buildId||target.version)) return false;
  fkiSaveSafely();
  // Only refresh an existing SW if already installed. Do not create SW, clear caches or user progress.
  try{
    if('serviceWorker' in navigator){
      const reg=await navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistration();
      if(reg && reg.update) await Promise.race([reg.update().catch(()=>{}),new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,650))]);
    }
  } catch(e){}
  const u=fkiFreshURL(target.url,FKI_REFRESH_PARAMETER);
  // A release filename is immutable, so it is not affected by a cached index.html.
  location.replace(u.href);
  return true;
}
function fkiShowRefreshNotice(target){
  if(!target)return;
  fkiPendingTarget=target;
  v37ShowUpdateNotice(target.version);
  const desc=$('updateNoticeBody');
  if(desc) desc.textContent='新しい公開版を確認しました。再読み込みすると新しいゲームを開きます。';
}
async function fkiReloadLatest(){
  const t=fkiPendingTarget;
  if(t) {await fkiNavigateVerified(t,'manual');return;}
  if(!/^https?:$/.test(location.protocol)){showToast('ダウンロード版は自動更新できません。公開URLから開いてね。');return;}
  await fkiCheckLatest({manual:true,automatic:true,reason:'button'});
}
async function fkiCheckLatest({manual=false,automatic=false,reason='startup'}={}){
  // Skip repeat checks on rapid tab switching. Manual checks always run.
  if(!manual && Date.now()-fkiLastCheckedAt<45000) return false;
  if(!manual) fkiLastCheckedAt=Date.now();
  if(!/^https?:$/.test(location.protocol)){
    if(manual) showToast('保存したHTMLは自動更新できません。公開URLから開いてね。');
    return false;
  }
  if(fkiCheckInFlight) return fkiCheckInFlight;
  fkiCheckInFlight=(async()=>{
    let target=null;
    try{target=await fkiReadManifest()}
    catch(e){
      // Standalone index.html without an optional manifest: still check a cache-busted copy of itself.
      try{target=await fkiProbeRemoteHead()}catch(err){
        if(manual)showToast('更新確認ができませんでした。ゲームはこのまま遊べます。');
        return false;
      }
    }
    // Ignore stale manifests and never downgrade to an older version.
    const cmp=v37CompareVersion(target.version,APP_VERSION);
    const changed=cmp>0||(cmp===0&&!!target.buildId&&target.buildId!==FKI_BUILD_ID);
    if(!changed){v37HideUpdateNotice();if(manual)showToast(`Ver.${APP_VERSION} は現在の公開版です。`);return false;}
    // Never interrupt a user who is actively playing; show a notice instead.
    const playing=!!document.querySelector('#play.active,#modalWrap.open');
    if(automatic&&!playing){
      const ok=await fkiNavigateVerified(target,reason);
      if(ok)return true;
    }
    fkiShowRefreshNotice(target);
    return true;
  })();
  try{return await fkiCheckInFlight}finally{fkiCheckInFlight=null}
}
function fkiBootVersionUpdater(){
  v37EnsureUpdateNotice();
  // The small gateway has already checked version.json in this tab.
  let gatewayVerified=false;
  try {
    const checked=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('fki_gate_checked_'+FKI_FLAVOR)||'null');
    gatewayVerified=!!(checked&&checked.buildId===FKI_BUILD_ID&&Date.now()-checked.ts<60000);
  } catch(e) {}
  if(gatewayVerified) fkiLastCheckedAt=Date.now();
  else setTimeout(()=>fkiCheckLatest({automatic:true,reason:'startup'}),500);
  window.addEventListener('pageshow',e=>{if(e.persisted)fkiCheckLatest({automatic:true,reason:'back-forward-cache'})});
  window.addEventListener('online',()=>fkiCheckLatest({automatic:true,reason:'reconnect'}));
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(!document.hidden)fkiCheckLatest({automatic:true,reason:'tab-return'})});
}
fkiBootVersionUpdater();


/* Version 3.23: remember a successfully opened release and pause hidden-screen animations. */
(function(){
  const currentFolder = new URL('./',location.href).pathname;
  const goodKey = 'fki_last_good_'+currentFolder+'_'+FKI_FLAVOR;
  if(/^https?:$/.test(location.protocol)){
    try { localStorage.setItem(goodKey,JSON.stringify({file:location.pathname.split('/').pop(),version:APP_VERSION,buildId:FKI_BUILD_ID,ts:Date.now()})); } catch(e){}
  }
  const setVisibility=()=>document.documentElement.classList.toggle('fki318-page-hidden',document.hidden);
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',setVisibility,{passive:true});
  setVisibility();
})();

let fki324StartTimer=0;
const fki324OriginalOpenModal=openModal;
openModal=function(kind,title,body){
 const modal=document.getElementById('modalWrap');
 modal?.classList.toggle('fki324-quiz-visible',kind==='staffquiz');
 if(kind!=='staffquiz')modal?.classList.remove('fki324-mini-visible');
 return fki324OriginalOpenModal(kind,title,body);
};
let staffMode=false, staffPassed=[];
try{staffMode=localStorage.getItem(STAFF_MODE_KEY)==='1'; const old=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STAFF_SCORE_KEY)||'[]');if(Array.isArray(old))staffPassed=[...new Set(old.filter(x=>Number.isInteger(x)&&x>=1&&x<=12))];}catch(_){ }
function safeStore(){try{localStorage.setItem(STAFF_MODE_KEY,staffMode?'1':'0');localStorage.setItem(STAFF_SCORE_KEY,JSON.stringify(staffPassed));}catch(_){}}
function modeButton(title,value){return `<button type="button" class="fki323-mode-btn ${staffMode===value?'active':''}" data-fki323-mode="${value?'staff':'normal'}" aria-pressed="${staffMode===value}">${title}</button>`;}
function ensureModeUI(){
 const title=document.querySelector('#home .heroActions');
 if(title&&!document.getElementById('fki323-title-mode')){
  const div=document.createElement('div');div.id='fki323-title-mode';div.className='fki323-title-mode';
  const marker=title.querySelector('#newGame'); title.insertBefore(div,marker||title.firstElementChild);
  div.addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-fki323-mode]');if(b)setStaffMode(b.dataset.fki323Mode==='staff');});
 }
 const stage=document.querySelector('#play .v26-stage');
 if(stage&&!document.getElementById('fki323-play-mode')){
  const div=document.createElement('div');div.id='fki323-play-mode';div.className='fki323-play-mode';
  const bottom=stage.querySelector('.v26-bottom'); stage.insertBefore(div,bottom||null);
  div.addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-fki323-mode]');if(b)setStaffMode(b.dataset.fki323Mode==='staff');});
 }
 syncModeUI();
}
function syncModeUI(){
 document.body.classList.toggle('fki323-staff-active',staffMode);
 const title=document.getElementById('fki323-title-mode');
 if(title)title.innerHTML=`<span class="fki323-mode-label">モードを選ぶ</span><span class="fki323-toggle">${modeButton('たんけん',false)}${modeButton('藤江従事者用',true)}</span>`;
 const play=document.getElementById('fki323-play-mode');
 if(play)play.innerHTML=`<span class="fki323-toggle">${modeButton('たんけん',false)}${modeButton('藤江従事者用',true)}</span><span class="fki323-progress">${staffMode?'安全クイズ：'+staffPassed.length+' / 12 問':''}</span>`;
 if(staffMode){const status=document.getElementById('fki323-staff-warning');if(!status){const box=document.createElement('div');box.id='fki323-staff-warning';box.setAttribute('role','note');box.textContent='※実作業は藤江の正式マニュアル・現場責任者・機器説明書を優先。';document.querySelector('#fki323-play-mode')?.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',box)}}else document.getElementById('fki323-staff-warning')?.remove();
}
function setStaffMode(on){clearTimeout(fki324StartTimer);staffMode=!!on;safeStore();syncModeUI();if(document.querySelector('#play.active')&&typeof showToast==='function')showToast(staffMode?'従事者用の安全クイズに切り替えたよ':'たんけんモードに戻ったよ');}
function renderStaffQuiz(id,selected=[],review=null){
 const d=DEVICES.find(x=>x.id===id), q=STAFF_QUESTIONS[id];if(!d||!q)return;
 const multi=q.kind==='multiple';
 const full=selected.slice().sort((a,b)=>a-b).join(',')===q.correct.slice().sort((a,b)=>a-b).join(',');
 const correct=review==='correct',wrong=review==='wrong';
 const options=q.options.map((text,i)=>`<button type="button" class="fki323-opt ${selected.includes(i)?'chosen':''}" data-fki323-answer="${i}" aria-pressed="${selected.includes(i)}" ${review?'disabled':''}><span class="fki323-letter">${'ABCD'[i]}</span><span>${v26E(text)}</span>${multi?'<span class="fki323-check">'+(selected.includes(i)?'✓':'')+'</span>':''}</button>`).join('');
 const src=STAFF_REFERENCES[q.source],stat=q.status==='local'?'※ 機種・現場の手順も確認してください。':'';
 const feedback=review?`<div class="fki323-feedback ${correct?'good':'bad'}" role="status"><strong>${correct?'正解！':'もう一度確認しよう'}</strong><p>${v26E(q.explain)}</p></div>`:'';
 const quizTitle=`藤江従事者用　${String(id).padStart(2,'0')} ／ ${dName(d)}`;
 const quizBody=`<div data-fki325-multi="${multi}" class="fki323-quiz ${review?'fki324-reviewed':''}"><div class="fki323-quiz-progress"><span>設備 ${id} / 12</span><span>クリア ${staffPassed.length} / 12</span></div><p class="fki323-question">${v26E(q.question)}</p><div class="fki323-answer-grid">${options}</div>${feedback}<p class="fki323-source"><a href="${src}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">根拠資料</a><span>${v26E(stat)}</span></p><div class="fki323-quiz-actions"><button type="button" id="fki323-quiz-back" class="fki323-quiet">マップへ戻る</button>${!review?`<button type="button" id="fki323-quiz-check" ${selected.length===0?'disabled':''}>${multi?'答え合わせ':'答える'}</button>`:wrong?'<button type="button" id="fki323-quiz-retry">もう一度</button>':`<button type="button" id="fki323-quiz-next">${'ミニゲームへ進む'}</button>`}</div></div>`;
 if(modalKind==='staffquiz' && document.getElementById('modalWrap')?.classList.contains('open')){
  document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent=quizTitle;
  document.getElementById('modalBody').innerHTML=quizBody;
 }else openModal('staffquiz',quizTitle,quizBody);
  document.getElementById('modalWrap')?.classList.add('fki324-quiz-visible');
 document.getElementById('fki323-quiz-back')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{clearTimeout(fki324StartTimer);closeModal();});
 const root=document.querySelector('#modalBody .fki323-quiz');
 if(!review)root?.querySelectorAll('[data-fki323-answer]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  const n=Number(btn.dataset.fki323Answer);const next=multi?(selected.includes(n)?selected.filter(x=>x!==n):[...selected,n]):[n];
  renderStaffQuiz(id,next,null);
  // Four-choice quiz: one click answers. Multiple-answer quiz retains its check button.
  if(!multi)document.getElementById('fki323-quiz-check')?.click();
 }));
 document.getElementById('fki323-quiz-check')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  if(!selected.length)return;
  if(full&&!staffPassed.includes(id)){staffPassed.push(id);staffPassed.sort((a,b)=>a-b);safeStore();syncModeUI()}
  clearTimeout(fki324StartTimer);
  renderStaffQuiz(id,selected,full?'correct':'wrong');
  if(full){
    fki324StartTimer=setTimeout(()=>{
      if(modalKind!=='staffquiz'||!document.getElementById('modalWrap')?.classList.contains('open'))return;
      // Immediately play the same device's original minigame. No extra intro click.
      activeId=id;
      regularOpenMission(id);
      beginMission();
      const wrap=document.getElementById('modalWrap');
      wrap?.classList.add('fki324-mini-visible');
      const notice=document.createElement('div');notice.className='fki324-mini-notice';notice.textContent='正解！ ミニゲームへ';
      document.getElementById('modalBody')?.prepend(notice);
      setTimeout(()=>notice.remove(),1400);
    },950);
  }
 });
 document.getElementById('fki323-quiz-retry')?.addEventListener('click',()=>renderStaffQuiz(id,[],null));
 document.getElementById('fki323-quiz-next')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{clearTimeout(fki324StartTimer);activeId=id;regularOpenMission(id);beginMission();document.getElementById('modalWrap')?.classList.add('fki324-mini-visible');});
 document.getElementById('fki323-regular-mission')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{clearTimeout(fki324StartTimer);activeId=id;regularOpenMission(id);beginMission();document.getElementById('modalWrap')?.classList.add('fki324-mini-visible');});
 const preferred=review==='wrong'?document.getElementById('fki323-quiz-retry'):
   review==='correct'?document.getElementById('fki323-quiz-next'):
   document.querySelector(`[data-fki323-answer="${selected.length?selected[selected.length-1]:0}"]`);
 if(preferred)requestAnimationFrame(()=>{try{preferred.focus({preventScroll:true})}catch(_){}});
}
function renderStaffComplete(){
 openModal('staffquiz','藤江従事者用　全12問クリア',`<div class="fki323-quiz fki323-all-clear"><h3>安全クイズ 12 / 12</h3><p>12設備の安全・衛生のポイントを確認できたね。</p><p class="fki323-disclaimer">この記録はアプリ内の学習履歴です。藤江の正式な研修修了認定ではありません。</p><div class="fki323-quiz-actions"><button id="fki323-quiz-back">マップへ戻る</button></div></div>`);
 document.getElementById('fki323-quiz-back')?.addEventListener('click',closeModal);
}
const regularOpenMission=openMission;
openMission=function(id){if(staffMode)renderStaffQuiz(Number(id),[],null);else regularOpenMission(id)};
const baseShowScreen=showScreen;
showScreen=function(id){baseShowScreen(id);requestAnimationFrame(ensureModeUI)};

// Move each secret book into a part of its room that has no overlap with the equipment labels.
// This is a bounded search, called only after a board rebuild or viewport resize.
function positionSecretsWithoutTextOverlap(){
 const grid=document.getElementById('v26-room-grid'); if(!grid)return;
 for(const book of grid.querySelectorAll('.v26-room .v26-secret')){
  const room=book.closest('.v26-room');if(!room)continue;
  const roomBox=room.getBoundingClientRect(),bw=book.offsetWidth,bh=book.offsetHeight;
  if(!bw||!bh||roomBox.width<=bw+10||roomBox.height<=bh+10)continue;
  const textNodes=[...room.querySelectorAll('.v26-room-head h2,.v26-room-head small,.v26-device strong,.v26-number')];
  const textBoxes=textNodes.map(el=>el.getBoundingClientRect()).filter(r=>r.width&&r.height);
  const artBoxes=[...room.querySelectorAll('.v26-device img')].map(el=>el.getBoundingClientRect()).filter(r=>r.width&&r.height);
  const xs=[roomBox.width-bw-5,roomBox.width-bw-13,Math.max(6,roomBox.width-bw-30),6,Math.max(6,(roomBox.width-bw)/2)];
  const ys=[5,16,32,Math.max(5,roomBox.height-bh-7),Math.max(5,roomBox.height/2-bh/2)];
  const area=(r,s)=>Math.max(0,Math.min(r.right,s.right)-Math.max(r.left,s.left))*Math.max(0,Math.min(r.bottom,s.bottom)-Math.max(r.top,s.top));
  let best=[xs[0],ys[0]],score=Infinity;
  for(let a=0;a<xs.length;a++)for(let b=0;b<ys.length;b++){
   const x=Math.max(3,Math.min(xs[a],roomBox.width-bw-3)),y=Math.max(3,Math.min(ys[b],roomBox.height-bh-3));
   const r={left:roomBox.left+x-4,right:roomBox.left+x+bw+4,top:roomBox.top+y-4,bottom:roomBox.top+y+bh+4};
   const textOverlap=textBoxes.reduce((v,t)=>v+area(r,t),0),artOverlap=artBoxes.reduce((v,t)=>v+area(r,t),0);
   const s=textOverlap*800+artOverlap*.025+Math.hypot(x-(roomBox.width-bw-7),y-5)*.18;
   if(s<score){score=s;best=[x,y]}
  }
  book.style.setProperty('left',best[0]+'px','important');book.style.setProperty('top',best[1]+'px','important');
  book.style.setProperty('right','auto','important');book.style.setProperty('bottom','auto','important');book.style.setProperty('transform','none','important');
  book.dataset.fki323NoTextOverlap=score<800?'true':'best-effort';
 }
}
const baseRenderBoard=v26RenderBoard;
v26RenderBoard=function(){baseRenderBoard();requestAnimationFrame(positionSecretsWithoutTextOverlap);setTimeout(positionSecretsWithoutTextOverlap,150)};
window.addEventListener('resize',()=>setTimeout(positionSecretsWithoutTextOverlap,180));
if(document.getElementById('v26-room-grid'))setTimeout(positionSecretsWithoutTextOverlap,180);
ensureModeUI();
})();

})();
</script><script>/* FKI Ver.3.25 – Browser Gamepad API adapter for USB XInput and Bluetooth ABXY controllers.
   Uses actual HTML controls and existing keyboard handlers; never changes save data or game rules. */
(()=>{

let swapAB=false;
try { swapAB=localStorage.getItem(KEY)==='1'; } catch(e) {}
let selected=null, focused=null, padIndex=-1, prev=[], lastNav=0, lastRepeat=0, lastHold=0, lastTime=performance.now();
let diagnosticOpen=false, diagnosticFrameTime=0, diagnosticLast='';
let diagnosticReturnFocus=null;
let keyboardHeld=new Set(), lastAnnouncement='', announceUntil=0, connectionAnnounced=false;
const $=(s,root=document)=>root.querySelector(s);
const pressed=(p,i)=>!!(p.buttons?.[i]?.pressed || p.buttons?.[i]?.value>.58);
const axis=(p,i)=>Math.abs(Number(p.axes?.[i]||0))>.28?Number(p.axes[i]):0;
const indicator=document.createElement('div');
indicator.id='fki321-pad-indicator';indicator.setAttribute('role','status');indicator.setAttribute('aria-live','polite');
indicator.setAttribute('aria-atomic','true');document.body.appendChild(indicator);
const st=document.createElement('style');st.id='fki321-pad-css';st.textContent=`
#fki321-pad-indicator{position:fixed;z-index:990;left:50%;top:max(7px,env(safe-area-inset-top));transform:translateX(-50%);padding:8px 16px;max-width:calc(100vw - 24px);min-width:0;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid #d4e1e5;background:#164460;color:#fff;font:700 12px/1.5 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Yu Gothic',Meiryo,sans-serif;text-align:center;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .23s ease;pointer-events:none;box-shadow:0 4px 13px #0002;white-space:normal}
#fki321-pad-indicator.is-visible{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
.fki321-pad-focused{outline:4px solid #efaf32!important;outline-offset:3px!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #194b69!important;position:relative;z-index:5}
@media(max-width:720px){#fki321-pad-indicator{font-size:11px;padding:7px 9px;width:max-content;max-width:calc(100vw - 16px)}.fki321-pad-focused{outline-width:3px!important;outline-offset:1px!important}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#fki321-pad-indicator{transition:none!important}}

#fki322-diagnostic{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1200;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(8,26,41,.84);padding:16px;font:700 14px/1.7 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Yu Gothic',Meiryo,sans-serif}
#fki322-diagnostic.open{display:flex}

#fki322-diagnostic h2{font-size:21px;margin:0 0 10px;color:#205d7b}
#fki322-diagnostic p{font-size:13px;margin:7px 0}
#fki322-diagnostic output{display:block;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;padding:12px;background:#eef6f7;border:1px solid #cadfe5;border-radius:10px;min-height:94px;font:700 13px/1.7 monospace}
#fki322-diagnostic button{border:0;border-radius:99px;background:#156e9c;color:#fff;padding:11px 24px;min-height:44px;margin-top:16px;cursor:pointer}
@media(max-width:720px){#fki322-diagnostic .panel{padding:16px}#fki322-diagnostic h2{font-size:18px}}
`;document.head.appendChild(st);
function notice(message,ms=3600){indicator.textContent=message;lastAnnouncement=message;announceUntil=performance.now()+ms;indicator.classList.add('is-visible')}
function releaseKeys(){for(const code of keyboardHeld)dispatchKey('keyup',code);keyboardHeld.clear()}
function dispatchKey(type,code){try{document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(type,{key:code==='Space'?' ':code.startsWith('Arrow')?code.slice(5):code,code,bubbles:true,cancelable:true}));}catch(e){}}
function syncKeys(want){for(const code of keyboardHeld)if(!want.has(code)){dispatchKey('keyup',code);keyboardHeld.delete(code)}for(const code of want)if(!keyboardHeld.has(code)){dispatchKey('keydown',code);keyboardHeld.add(code)}}
function clearFocus(){if(focused)focused.classList.remove(ACTIVE);focused=null;selected=null}
function activeRoot(){
 for(const s of ['#v311-detail-cover','#v310-detail-cover','#v311-detail-cover','#v36-card-preview']){const el=$(s);if(el&&el.getClientRects().length)return el}
 const modal=$('#modalWrap.open');if(modal)return modal;
 const screens=[...document.querySelectorAll('.screen.active')];return screens[screens.length-1]||document.body;
}
function isUsable(el){
 if(!el||!el.isConnected||el.disabled||el.hidden||el.closest('[hidden],[inert]'))return false;
 const cs=getComputedStyle(el),r=el.getBoundingClientRect();
 return cs.display!=='none'&&cs.visibility!=='hidden'&&cs.pointerEvents!=='none'&&r.width>=7&&r.height>=7;
}
function options(){
 const root=activeRoot();
 return [...root.querySelectorAll('button:not([disabled]),a[href],[role="button"],[tabindex="0"]')]
  .filter(el=>isUsable(el)&&!el.closest('#fki321-pad-indicator')&&(!el.closest('.screen')||el.closest('.screen')===root||root.contains(el)));
}
function focusOn(el){
 if(!isUsable(el))return false;
 if(focused&&focused!==el)focused.classList.remove(ACTIVE);
 focused=el;selected=el;el.classList.add(ACTIVE);
 try{el.focus({preventScroll:true})}catch(e){}
 const scroller=el.closest('#v26-board-scroller,.modalBody,.v311-book-stage');
 if(scroller)try{el.scrollIntoView({behavior:'auto',block:'nearest',inline:'nearest'})}catch(e){}
 return true;
}
function defaultChoice(){
 const root=activeRoot();
 for(const s of ['#newGame','#storyNext','#choiceGrid .selected','#goAdventure','#launchStart',
  '#v311-album-root .v311-slot.unlocked','#v311-next',
  '#v26-wash-start','#v26-rapid-start','#v28-hand-start','#v28-sink-start','#v28-love-start',
  '#v28-love-stop','#v28-love-complete','#startMission','#beginMission',
  '[data-v26-device]','#v311-preview-back','.modalBody button','#v26-mobile-menu-trigger','.heroActions button']){
   const x=$(s,root);if(isUsable(x))return x;
 }
 return options()[0]||null;
}
function ensureFocus(){if(!focused||!isUsable(focused)||!activeRoot().contains(focused))focusOn(defaultChoice())}
function nav(dx,dy){
 const opts=options();if(!opts.length)return;
 ensureFocus();if(opts.length===1){focusOn(opts[0]);return}
 const from=focused&&opts.includes(focused)?focused:(defaultChoice()||opts[0]);
 const fr=from.getBoundingClientRect();const fx=fr.left+fr.width/2,fy=fr.top+fr.height/2;
 let best=null,score=Infinity;
 for(const el of opts){if(el===from)continue;
  const r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),x=r.left+r.width/2-fx,y=r.top+r.height/2-fy;
  const along=x*dx+y*dy,across=Math.abs(x*dy-y*dx);
  if(along<=1)continue;
  const val=along+across*2.4+(across>along*2?200:0);
  if(val<score){best=el;score=val;}
 }
 if(!best){const order=opts.indexOf(from);best=opts[(order+(dx>0||dy>0?1:-1)+opts.length)%opts.length]}
 focusOn(best);
}
function safeClick(el){if(!el||!el.isConnected)return false;try{el.click();return true}catch(e){return false}}
function currentCapture(){const o=$('#cardCaptureOverlay.visible');return o&&getComputedStyle(o).display!=='none'?o:null}
function handActive(){const c=$('#v28-hand-canvas'),start=$('#v28-hand-start');return !!(c&&$('#modalWrap.open')&&!isUsable(start));}
function actionA(){
 const capture=currentCapture();if(capture){safeClick(capture);return}
 ensureFocus();const root=activeRoot();
 // The next button may be created just after a screen transition.
 if(root.id==='modalWrap'){
  for(const s of ['#v28-love-stop','#v28-love-complete','#v28-sink-continue']){
   const el=$(s,root);if(isUsable(el)){focusOn(el);return safeClick(el)}
  }
 }
 const el=focused&&root.contains(focused)?focused:defaultChoice();
 if(el){safeClick(el);setTimeout(()=>{if(padIndex>=0)ensureFocus()},80)}
}
function actionB(){
 const c=currentCapture();if(c){safeClick(c);return}
 const overlay=$('#v311-detail-cover,#v310-detail-cover');if(overlay){safeClick($('#v311-preview-back,#v310-preview-back',overlay));return}
 const modal=$('#modalWrap.open');
 if(modal){
  for(const s of ['#v28-back','#backIntro','#v311-map-back','#v310-map-back','#closeModal']){const e=$(s,modal);if(isUsable(e)){safeClick(e);return}}
  return;
 }
 const root=activeRoot();const ids={story:'#storyBack',choose:'#backHome',launch:'#launchBack'};
 if(ids[root.id]){safeClick($(ids[root.id],root));return}
 if(root.id==='play'){const menu=$('#v26-mobile-menu-trigger');if(menu)safeClick(menu)}
}
function shortcut(kind){
 if(currentCapture()||$('#modalWrap.open')||$('#v311-detail-cover,#v310-detail-cover'))return;
 const root=activeRoot();if(root?.id!=='play'&&root?.id!=='end')return;
 const sel=kind==='cards'?'[data-v26-action="cards"]':kind==='help'?'[data-v26-action="help"]':'#v26-mobile-menu-trigger';
 let e=$(sel,root);if(!e&&kind==='cards')e=$('#v26-end-cards');if(e)safeClick(e);
}
function turnPage(right){
 const modal=$('#modalWrap.open');if(!modal){nav(right?1:-1,0);return}
 for(const s of [right?'#v311-next':'#v311-prev',right?'#v310-next':'#v310-prev',right?'#starNext':'#starPrev']){
  const e=$(s,modal);if(isUsable(e)){safeClick(e);return}
 }
 nav(right?1:-1,0);
}
function disconnect(){
 if(padIndex<0)return;
 padIndex=-1;prev=[];releaseKeys();clearFocus();connectionAnnounced=false;
 notice('ゲームパッドの接続が切れました',2300);
}

const diagnostic=document.createElement('div');
diagnostic.id='fki322-diagnostic';
diagnostic.setAttribute('role','dialog');diagnostic.setAttribute('aria-modal','true');diagnostic.setAttribute('aria-label','コントローラー動作確認');
diagnostic.innerHTML='<div class="panel"><h2>コントローラーの動作確認</h2><p>USB・Bluetoothで接続し、いずれかのボタンを押してください。番号とスティックの動きを表示します。</p><output id="fki322-diag-output" role="status" aria-live="off">接続を確認しています。</output><p>ブラウザが認識しない場合は、Windowsのゲームコントローラー設定で接続を確認してください。</p><button type="button" id="fki322-diag-close">閉じる</button></div>';
document.body.appendChild(diagnostic);
function closeDiagnostic(){diagnosticOpen=false;diagnostic.classList.remove('open');diagnosticLast='';if(diagnosticReturnFocus?.isConnected)try{diagnosticReturnFocus.focus({preventScroll:true})}catch(e){}}
function openDiagnostic(){releaseKeys();clearFocus();diagnosticReturnFocus=document.activeElement;diagnosticOpen=true;diagnostic.classList.add('open');diagnosticLast='';renderDiagnostic(null,performance.now(),true);$('#fki322-diag-close').focus({preventScroll:true});}
$('#fki322-diag-close').addEventListener('click',closeDiagnostic);
diagnostic.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===diagnostic)closeDiagnostic()});
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(diagnosticOpen&&e.key==='Escape'){closeDiagnostic();e.stopPropagation();e.preventDefault()}},true);
function renderDiagnostic(pad,now,force=false){
 if(!diagnosticOpen || (!force && now-diagnosticFrameTime<80))return;
 diagnosticFrameTime=now;
 const view=$('#fki322-diag-output');if(!view)return;
 const lines=pad?[
  '状態：接続中',
  '機器：'+String(pad.id||'名称なし').slice(0,100),
  '方式：'+(pad.mapping==='standard'?'標準 ABXY':'機種独自のボタン配置（調整が必要な可能性）'),
  '押されているボタン番号：'+(pad.buttons||[]).map((x,i)=>x?.pressed||x?.value>.58?i:null).filter(x=>x!==null).join(', ').replace(/^$/,'なし'),
  'スティック：'+(pad.axes||[]).map((a,i)=>'軸'+i+'='+Number(a||0).toFixed(2)).join('　'),
  'ABXY入れ替え：'+(swapAB?'オン':'オフ')
 ]:['状態：未接続\nUSB・Bluetoothの接続と、ブラウザ上でのボタン入力を確認してください。'];
 const str=lines.join('\n');if(force||str!==diagnosticLast){view.textContent=str;diagnosticLast=str}
}

function poll(now){
 try{
 if(!document.hidden){
  const pads=Array.from(navigator.getGamepads()||[]).filter(Boolean).filter(p=>p.connected!==false);
  const pad=pads.find(p=>p.index===padIndex)||pads[0];
  if(!pad){disconnect();renderDiagnostic(null,now)}else{
   renderDiagnostic(pad,now);
   if(diagnosticOpen){
    const last=prev;
    const back=pressed(pad,1)&&!last[1];
    prev=Array.from({length:Math.max(18,pad.buttons?.length||0)},(_,i)=>pressed(pad,i));
    if(back)closeDiagnostic();
   } else {
   if(padIndex!==pad.index){padIndex=pad.index;prev=[];clearFocus();releaseKeys();connectionAnnounced=false;}
   if(!connectionAnnounced){connectionAnnounced=true;notice('コントローラー接続中｜十字キー・スティック：選択　A：決定　B：戻る　X：カード　Y：遊び方　START：メニュー',5000);ensureFocus();}
   const last=prev,read=i=>pressed(pad,i),edge=i=>read(i)&&!last[i];
   const a=swapAB?1:0,b=swapAB?0:1,x=swapAB?3:2,y=swapAB?2:3;
   const left=read(14)||axis(pad,0)<-.55,right=read(15)||axis(pad,0)>.55;
   const up=read(12)||axis(pad,1)<-.55,down=read(13)||axis(pad,1)>.55;
   const hand=handActive();
   if(hand){
    let want=new Set();
    if(left)want.add('ArrowLeft');if(right)want.add('ArrowRight');
    if(up)want.add('ArrowUp');if(down)want.add('ArrowDown');
    if(read(a))want.add('Space');syncKeys(want);
   }else{
    if(keyboardHeld.size)releaseKeys();
    const d=left&&!right?[-1,0]:right&&!left?[1,0]:up&&!down?[0,-1]:down&&!up?[0,1]:null;
    if(d){
     const stamp=d.join(',');
     if(stamp!==lastNav||now-lastRepeat>170){nav(...d);lastNav=stamp;lastRepeat=now}
    }else{lastNav=0;lastRepeat=0}
   }
   const combo=read(8)&&edge(9);
   if(combo){swapAB=!swapAB;try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,swapAB?'1':'0')}catch(e){}notice('ABXY入れ替え：'+(swapAB?'オン':'オフ')+'（SELECT＋STARTで切り替え）',4200)}
   else{
    if(edge(a)){
     if(hand){const start=$('#v28-hand-start');if(isUsable(start))safeClick(start)}
     else actionA();
    }
    if(!hand){
     if(edge(b))actionB();
     if(edge(x))shortcut('cards');
     if(edge(y))shortcut('help');
     if(edge(9))shortcut('menu');
     if(edge(4))turnPage(false);
     if(edge(5))turnPage(true);
     const rapid=$('#v26-rapid-tap');
     if(read(a)&&isUsable(rapid)&&now-lastHold>115){safeClick(rapid);lastHold=now}
    }
   }
   prev=Array.from({length:Math.max(18,pad.buttons?.length||0)},(_,i)=>read(i));
   } // !diagnosticOpen
  }
 }
 if(announceUntil&&now>announceUntil){indicator.classList.remove('is-visible');announceUntil=0}
 }catch(e){if(!window.__FKI321_PAD_ERROR){window.__FKI321_PAD_ERROR=String(e)}}
 if(padIndex>=0 && !document.hidden){requestAnimationFrame(poll)}
 else{setTimeout(()=>requestAnimationFrame(poll),document.hidden?500:200)}
}
window.addEventListener('gamepadconnected',()=>{connectionAnnounced=false},{passive:true});
window.addEventListener('gamepaddisconnected',e=>{if(e.gamepad?.index===padIndex)disconnect()},{passive:true});
window.addEventListener('blur',()=>{releaseKeys();lastNav=0;lastRepeat=0},{passive:true});
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden){releaseKeys();lastNav=0;lastRepeat=0}},{passive:true});
window.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(!e.target.closest('#fki321-pad-indicator'))clearFocus()},{passive:true});
// Keep the on-screen instructions consistent with the added controls.
const helpBody=$('#modalBody');
if(helpBody){
  const updateHelp=()=>{
    const title=$('#modalTitle')?.textContent||'';
    if(!title.includes('遊び方')||!$('#modalWrap.open')||$('#fki321-help-text'))return;
    const note=document.createElement('section');note.id='fki321-help-text';
    note.style.cssText='margin:14px 0 4px;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid #b5ccd8;border-radius:10px;background:#f1f8fa;color:#254e64;font-size:13px;line-height:1.8;text-align:left';
    note.innerHTML='<strong>ゲームパッド操作（USB／Bluetooth）</strong><div>十字キー・左スティック：選ぶ　A：決定　B：戻る</div><div>X：カードファイル　Y：遊び方　START：メニュー</div><div>L1／R1：ページ切り替え　SELECT＋START：ABXY配置切り替え</div><div>手洗い：方向キーで動かしながらAを長押し</div>';
    const diagnosticButton=document.createElement('button');
    diagnosticButton.id='fki322-pad-diagnostic-button';diagnosticButton.type='button';
    diagnosticButton.textContent='コントローラーの動作確認';
    diagnosticButton.style.cssText='display:block;margin-top:10px;border-radius:99px;border:0;background:#176b95;color:#fff;min-height:44px;padding:9px 18px;font-size:13px;font-weight:850';
    diagnosticButton.addEventListener('click',openDiagnostic);
    note.appendChild(diagnosticButton);
    helpBody.appendChild(note);
  };
  new MutationObserver(updateHelp).observe(helpBody,{childList:true});
  document.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target.closest('[data-v26-action="help"]'))setTimeout(updateHelp,50)},{capture:true,passive:true});
}
window.__FKI321_PAD_INFO=()=>({connected:padIndex>=0,padIndex,swapAB,focused:focused?.id||focused?.dataset?.v26Device||focused?.textContent?.trim().slice(0,25)||null,error:window.__FKI321_PAD_ERROR||null});
requestAnimationFrame(poll);
})();
</script><script id="fki325-startup-polish">(()=>{'use strict';
const root=document.documentElement;
function visibility(){root.classList.toggle('fki325-idle',document.hidden)}
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',visibility,{passive:true});visibility();
// Keep decorative images off the critical decoding path; the cover remains eager.
document.querySelectorAll('.screen:not(.active) img').forEach(img=>{if(!img.hasAttribute('loading'))img.loading='lazy';if(!img.hasAttribute('decoding'))img.decoding='async'});
})();</script></body></html>
